mapper.select: SELECT AVG(total_score) FROM ai_exams WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND question_count = 5 AND total_score IS NOT NULL AND total_score > 0

SELECT video_id as videoId, ROUND(AVG(total_score), 2) as averageScore, COUNT(*) as attemptCount FROM ai_exams WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'submitted' AND video_id IS NOT NULL AND total_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY video_id ORDER BY video_id

SELECT document_id as documentId, ROUND(AVG(total_score), 2) as averageScore, COUNT(*) as attemptCount FROM ai_exams WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'submitted' AND document_id IS NOT NULL AND total_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY document_id ORDER BY document_id
